messages:
sam: Heads-up — we're seeing a sudden eviction storm on ap-southeast-2 GPU hosts starting ~02:14 UTC. Affected scheduler shards are requeuing a lot of jobs and a few hosted customers hit 504s. Opening incident thread.
liam: oncall here. temporarily cordoned the affected host group and enabled region-fallback routing to hosted-us-east for critical routes. traffic shifted; error spikes dropped but tail latency increased for routed requests.
nana: tagging customer-success — sending a holding note to impacted customers now. cc @support.
deploy-bot: autoscale-controller: triggered emergency scale-up for ap-southeast-2 (add 6 nodes). request id=scale-20260323-01.
aiops-bot: anomaly-detect: detected kv-server IO saturation correlated with eviction events (p95 IO wait increased x4). Suggest throttling reenqueue to reduce pressure.
liam: confirmed correlation. throttled scheduler reenqueue for the region and disabled fast-retry for pending jobs. also applied a temporary cache-read-backoff. monitoring shows queue depth dropping ~40%.
support: customer update sent to 12 impacted customers. snippet: "We experienced degraded performance and intermittent 504s due to host evictions in ap-southeast-2. We've shifted critical traffic to a fallback region and applied mitigations; full recovery is in progress."
sam: mitigation list: 1) cordon hosts (done), 2) routing fallback enabled (done), 3) throttle reenqueue (done), 4) emergency scale-up in progress (in flight), 5) outreach sent (done). status link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1864607890
liam: scale-up completed; new nodes joined but we're seeing a small reconciliation window while caches warm. rolling a config to avoid aggressive eviction thrashing (kernel-level niceness + adjusted docker oom score).
deploy-bot: deploy: config patch rolled to scheduler-apac v3.4.7, batch 1/2, sha=fa12be9.
sam: setting severity=SEV3 for now. will keep this thread open until p95 latency and error rates are within normal. scheduling a follow-up postmortem — ana to co-own customer comms. final RCA and timeline will be posted when we have it.
